comparisonTitle: Cafe Crisna Drink Menu Comprehensive Evaluation & Ranking
summary: This comprehensive menu comparison evaluates 45 beverage options from Cafe Crisna. Options are ranked from unsweetened herbal and plain drinks to heavy dessert beverages loaded with condensed milk and syrups, heavily penalizing choices that exacerbate the user's added sugar and calorie excesses.

groups.groupName: Tier 1 - Safest Choice: Plain & Herbal Brews
groups.comparisonSentence: This group contains the lowest calorie and zero-sugar beverages on the menu, making it significantly safer for users exceeding their daily added sugar limits.
groups.message: These plain brewed hot and iced teas, black coffees, and herbal ginger drinks offer negligible calories and zero added sugar. They help mitigate your current 50% added sugar excess and 39% calorie surplus. While they lack significant macronutrient density, they provide hydration without spiking blood glucose levels.
groups.orderingTip: Order completely unsweetened without any added simple syrup or sugar.

groups.groupName: Tier 2 - Moderate Choice: Fresh Fruit Juices & Pure Coconut Water
groups.comparisonSentence: Compared to heavily sweetened dessert drinks, these pure fruit juices and coconut waters provide beneficial dietary fiber, potassium, and vitamins despite natural fruit sugars.
groups.message: Fresh fruit juices and pure coconut water deliver valuable potassium (supporting your 2100mg baseline) and vitamin C, though they contain naturally occurring fructose. Because you are currently over your daily carbohydrate target by 32%, consume these in moderation. They lack significant protein and fat but offer vastly superior micronutrient profiles compared to synthetic syrups.
groups.orderingTip: Request 100% pure fruit juice with no added liquid sugar or simple syrup.

groups.groupName: Tier 3 - Caution Choice: Flavored Jellies, Yakult & Syrups
groups.comparisonSentence: Unlike pure juices, these flavored drinks and jelly beverages introduce substantial added sugars and artificial syrups that actively worsen your sugar surplus.
groups.message: These flavored mojitos, lychee Yakult drinks, and jelly-infused beverages combine fruit flavors with heavy syrup bases and processed gelatins. They contribute significantly to your 45g added sugar excess and elevate your caloric load without providing meaningful fiber or protein. Exercise caution and limit frequency.
groups.orderingTip: Ask for half-sweet or minimal syrup if available, and skip jelly toppings.

groups.groupName: Tier 4 - Alert Choice: Heavy Dessert Drinks & Condensed Milk Bowls
groups.comparisonSentence: These dessert bowls and avocado shakes pack extreme saturated fat and sugar loads that severely violate your calorie and added sugar targets.
groups.message: Encompassing Es Campur, Sop Buah, and avocado/durian shakes heavily laced with sweetened condensed milk and coconut cream, this group triggers an alert status. They deliver excessive saturated fats and massive sugar spikes that clash directly with your 38% saturated fat and 39% calorie surpluses. Avoid these items entirely to protect metabolic health.
groups.orderingTip: Strictly avoid ordering these dense dessert beverages; opt for plain tea or fresh coconut water instead.
